phenomenon: A freshly brewed cup of tea left to sit cools fastest in the first few minutes, then more and more slowly.
invariant: The fractional deviation from equilibrium decays in time with a single time constant; half-life = τ·ln2
operator: dx/dt = -(x - x*)/τ   (first order; τ is the time constant, eigenvalue λ = -1/τ)
game_instance: Resource depletion / energy exhaustion / stamina recovery; adaptive difficulty falling back to baseline

phenomenon: A bathtub filling at one end and draining at the other: the water level may rise or may fall.
invariant: With no sources or sinks the total is conserved: d(∫ρ)/dt = 0
operator: ∂ρ/∂t + ∇·J = S   (continuity equation; S is the source/sink)
game_instance: Resource production / consumption / inventory; Mario's triple ledger of coins, lives, and time

phenomenon: A snowball rolling one lap picks up a layer of snow; on the next lap it picks up even more.
invariant: The doubling time is constant: t₂ = ln2/k; proportional growth is unaffected by current size
game_instance: Progressive ball speed; Space Invaders speeds up as the enemy count drops; difficulty ramping

phenomenon: Walking with a nearly full cup of water: walk fast and it spills, walk slow and it still spills.
invariant: Perturbations are suppressed; overdamped / critically damped / underdamped is partitioned by ζ
operator: dx/dt = k(x* - x) - c·ẋ   (or second order: ẍ + 2ζωẋ + ω²x = 0)
game_instance: Adaptive difficulty; matching player strength; balance tuning

phenomenon: A balloon kept inflating suddenly bursts once it reaches a certain point.
invariant: A critical value x_c exists; past it the system enters another basin of attraction, and returning requires different conditions (hysteresis)
operator: f(x) is piecewise at x_c or changes sign there; bistable dx/dt = -dV/dx, V a double well
transfer: Critical temperature of a phase transition
game_instance: Power pellet triggers the offense/defense flip; health-line guard break; checkpoint mechanic

phenomenon: Bacteria in a culture medium keep growing, then stop at a certain number.
invariant: A ceiling K exists; the growth rate is maximal at x=K/2, forming an S-shaped curve
operator: dx/dt = k·x·(1 - x/K)   (logistic); or a saturating response x/(1+x/x₀)
game_instance: Level cap; remaining ammo; cognitive-load ceiling

phenomenon: Push a swing at the right moment and it swings higher and higher.
invariant: A natural frequency ω₀ exists; when the driving frequency approaches it the amplitude is amplified (quality factor Q)
operator: Complex eigenvalues of a second-order system λ = -ζω ± iω√(1-ζ²); under forcing the response is maximal at ω_drive = ω₀
game_instance: The sense of pressure from rhythm sound effects synced to frame rate; the feel and rhythm of combos

phenomenon: A drop of ink falls into clear water and slowly spreads out into a blur.
invariant: Mean squared displacement ∝ t (not t²); diffusion length L ~ √(Dt); the scale varies as √t
operator: ∂c/∂t = D∇²c   (Feynman–Kac: the path-integral solution in imaginary time)
game_instance: Exploration pacing on a fog-of-war map; the timescale of search and discovery

phenomenon: A single fallen leaf happens to plug the drain, and the whole pipe stops flowing.
invariant: An exact transition point p_c exists; connectivity differs qualitatively on the two sides of p_c; at the critical point the system is scale-invariant (power law with no characteristic scale)
operator: Branching mean k = ⟨number of offspring⟩; k<1 extinction, k=1 critical, k>1 giant component. Exact lattice threshold: bond percolation on the triangular lattice p_c = 2·sin(π/18) ≈ 0.3473; giant component P_∞(p) ∝ (p−p_c)^β; cluster size n_s ∝ s^(−τ)
game_instance: Chain propagation through a network of mechanics; social-spread-style gameplay

phenomenon: Burn a sheet of paper to ash, and no amount of piecing it together makes that sheet of paper again.
invariant: A state with λ=0 cannot be returned from; at the critical point the survival curve switches from exponential to power law
operator: Absorbing Markov chain: the transition matrix contains the eigenvalue λ=0. Mean-field contact process dρ/dt = a·ρ − b·ρ² ⇒ ρ_∞ = max(0, 1 − a/b); at criticality the survival rate S(t) ∝ t^(−δ), off criticality S(t) ∝ e^(−γt)
game_instance: Witchcraft's 'ashing' (a failed resurrection is permanent, no revival); overwriting a save; permadeath

phenomenon: Zoom the map in tenfold, and that stretch of coastline is still jagged in the same way.
invariant: The same rule takes the same form at different scales, with only its parameters changing (running coupling); at the fixed point the system is scale-invariant
operator: Coarse-graining transformation R; fixed point R*)=R; at the fixed point the scaling exponents are given by the linearized eigenvalues
game_instance: The scaled-up level structure of Super Mario's 8 worlds; self-similarity in difficulty tiers

phenomenon: The same road, pointed out to you by ten people in ten different ways, still gets you there.
invariant: An invariant = an element of the quotient set; every difference within an equivalence class is indistinguishable under observation
operator: Given an observation functional O and a transformation group G: O(g·x) = O(x) ∀g∈G ⇒ physical content = the equivalence-class space X/G. Electromagnetic example: A_μ → A_μ + ∂_μχ leaves F_μν = ∂_μA_ν − ∂_νA_μ invariant. This project's example: define a rewriting relation ~ on the set of surface phrasings; a rule = an element of the quotient set X/~
transfer: Gauge freedom of the electromagnetic potential
Arbitrary choice of the zero of energy
game_instance: 182 synonym families (energy exhausted / resources depleted / stamina exhausted...); different wordings of the same mechanic
